subject: PO aggregation & net-term tradeoffs for enterprise deployment
messages:
From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@orbitalhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@orbitalhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirements and consolidated invoicing question
Attachments: Orbital_PO_template.pdf (application/pdf, 72KB)

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — excited to move this forward. A few procurement constraints on our side that will shape how we complete the PO and invoice flow:

- We prefer one consolidated invoice per month per master PO (finance policy).
- Each invoice must reference the master PO number and the associated internal SKU mapping / charge lines.
- Standard net terms are Net60; finance will consider Net45 only with a documented justification (discount or prepayment).
- For onboarding we need your SOC 2 attestation, remit-to wiring details, and a filled PO template (attached).

Could you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Issue a single monthly invoice tied to a single PO even if usage varies week-to-week;
2) Put our SKU mapping into the invoice line items; and
3) Offer any discount for Net45 vs Net60?

If you can provide an example consolidated invoice (or invoice spec) that matches our template it will speed vendor onboarding.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a short call if that helps.

Regards,
Samantha Cho
Director, Procurement Operations
Orbital Health

--
ProcureOps <procureops@orbitalhealth.com>
Procurement team (attachments: Orbital_PO_template.pdf)

Subject: Re: PO requirements and consolidated invoicing question
Attachments: Redwood-invoice-specs.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB)

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes on consolidated invoices with PO linkage, and yes we can map SKU/line items if you provide the mapping. Net-term discounting is something we typically handle on a case-by-case basis.

A few details and constraints from our side:
- We can produce a monthly consolidated invoice per master PO that includes line-level SKU mapping and usage subtotals. Our invoice spec is attached.
- Because you mentioned variable usage, we typically do a monthly provisional invoice with a final reconciliation the following month (so your finance gets predictable monthly statements while we capture usage corrections).
- For Net45 vs Net60: we can offer a commercial concession, but discount levels depend on committed ARR and billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly vs annual).

Looping in Kimberly (finance lead) and Grace (customer success) to keep onboarding and billing aligned.

Next steps: if you can return the mapping in the attached PO template fields and confirm whether Orbital can accept a provisional + reconciliation cadence, we will draft a short commercial note that ties discount levels to term/commitment.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Hi Marcus / Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick reply. A few clarifications from procurement:
1) We can accept provisional monthly invoices with a one-month reconciliation provided the invoice clearly indicates provisional versus final amounts and references the PO number.
2) Net60 is our default. We are prepared to move to Net45 only if Redwood offers a commercial concession (either a % discount or an annual prepayment credit).
3) For our vendor onboarding we also need: SOC2 report (can be a link), contact for vendor remittance, and an example consolidated invoice.

Attached is a lightly populated PO template (the filled example column shows how our AP team expects SKU mapping). Please review and confirm whether Redwood can populate the SKU field on the invoice. Also, can you provide a short matrix that shows discount % at Net45 vs Net60 across commitment bands (0-250k, 250-750k, 750k+)? Procurement will use that to evaluate the Net-term trade.

Samantha Cho
Director, ProcureOps
Orbital Health

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements and consolidated invoicing question — proposed commercials and cadence
Attachments: SOW_v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 56KB); Offer_Summary.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 22KB)

Hi Samantha — appreciate the template and the onboarding checklist. Below is a concise proposal to unblock procurement quickly.

Commercial proposal (draft)
- Invoice cadence: Redwood will issue a consolidated monthly invoice tied to the master PO. Each invoice will include line-level SKU mapping that matches the populated PO template you sent.
- Provisional + reconciliation: We will send a provisional invoice on the 1st with final reconciliation by the 10th of the following month. Provisional amounts will be marked as such.
- Net term / discount matrix (applies to the committed ARR band over the initial 12-month term):
  * Net60 (baseline): no discount.
  * Net45: 2% discount off list for 0–250k ARR. 2.5% for 250–750k. 3% for 750k+.
  * Consolidated-invoice prompt-pay add-on: additional 0.75% discount if Orbital commits to the consolidated monthly cadence and allows automated ACH remittance.
  * 3-year annualized commit: additional 0.5% (stackable).

Notes and constraints
- Because usage can spike (pilot -> production), our provisional + reconciliation approach gives your AP predictable monthly invoices while allowing us to reconcile meter-based overages or underruns. If you need a fixed-billing cadence (e.g., fixed monthly fee regardless of usage), we can model that but it will change the commercials (higher baseline).
- We will require the remit-to entity and tax details to be present on the PO to prevent payment delays. Please confirm whether Orbital will pay to a US entity (Redwood Inference, Inc.) or a regional subsidiary; wire routing varies.

Next steps
1) Kimberly — can you confirm the discount bands above are finance-approvable on an interim basis?
2) Samantha — if the bands look ok, Marcus will produce a short amendment (1-pager) tying discounts to Net45 and consolidated cadence and share a sample consolidated invoice produced from your filled template.
3) If agreeable, schedule a 30-minute AP + finance sync to run through the sample invoice and remit-to details.

Happy to hop on a call Friday morning PST.

Best regards,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
